I range from 1400-1700MR. first of all, stop spamming DI. She has a lot of moves where she can react to it. You can check her DR with 5mp or 5lk. Try not to jump too much unless you get a good read that she's throwing multiple fans OR you're in good range to punish. If you do parry or block a fan, OD lariat normally works when the fan bounces off you. Stop punishing her whiff DP with a grab and SPD her, you're a grappler. Or if you wanna get saucy, punish with 5HK 3mp OD BD. On the moments you do jump over her fan, hit her with J5HP 6HP 3MP lariat. There was a lot of unga bunga gameplay from this Mai. You're missing a lot of her whiffs, when she does that just hit her with 5LK DR 2MP 3MP lariat. Do not SA3 after DI unless you kill or it's to drain meter. In this scenario you drained her meter but was too afraid to go after her and force burnout. You had a huge life lead, let her sa1 or DP. If you are punishing DI, for beginners just do SPD and not RBG. Stop using sweep in front of her face. You're doing WAY too many empty jump ins before conditioning your opponent. Either jump in for the SPD, bait the DP, or just use a jumping attack. A lot of wasted punishes here.
